steps.q: Does it make a great product or service?

views.text: In March 2026, Equity Mates outlined LinQ Minerals as a copper and gold explorer in NSW’s Central West, centred on the Gilmore Copper Gold Project spanning almost 600 square kilometres with a historic open pit, and cited estimates of over three million ounces of gold and over a million tonnes of copper in the ground.

views.text: In March 2026, Equity Mates said LinQ Minerals was actively drilling at Gilmore and accelerating the program with positive results, indicating current spend focused on exploration across five licences.

steps.q: Can it be bought at a reasonable price?

views.text: In March 2026, Equity Mates noted LinQ Minerals’ share price had risen about 165% over the past 12 months and had previously been up over 200% before a January pullback.
